## Checklist

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Content follows style guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Recommendations include reasoning (not just "use X")
- [ ] No vendor promotion without technical justification
- [ ] New commands follow the phase structure (scan → ask → preview → generate)
- [ ] New examples are command-oriented (walkthrough, showcase, or prompt library entry)
- [ ] New anti-patterns follow the 4-field structure (What it looks like, Why it happens, Why it fails, Fix)
- [ ] New eval entries are specific and realistic (not one-liners)
